akhfash:3-3.t: [He said] ﴿هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ (accusative) because His word ﴿الۤـمۤ [1] تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْكِتَابِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ﴾ [2] is definite, and this is a khabar (predicate) for the definite. «[Translator's note: i.e. it is accusative as a ḥāl coming after a complete definite statement.]»

akhfash:12-12.t: And He said ﴿أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ للَّهِ﴾: it is "that is: be grateful to Allah" (بِأَنِ اشْكُرِ اللهَ).

akhfash:14-14.t: And He said ﴿وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ﴾, i.e. at the end of two years; He did not mention "the end", just as He said ﴿وَسْئَلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ﴾, meaning the people of the town.

akhfash:16-16.t:
And He said ﴿إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ﴾ (if it should) amount to, i.e. "if a sin should be the weight of a grain". Some put it in the nominative and made it the "كانَ" that does not need a khabar (predicate), as though it were "if the weight of a grain should come to be".
And He said ﴿إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ﴾: He means "if the act of disobedience should be the weight of a mustard seed".

akhfash:21-21.t: And He said ﴿أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ﴾: here is the interrogative alif, which he put before the wāw of conjunction.

akhfash:27-27.t: And He said ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلاَمٌ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ﴾: (البحر is) nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and accusative by qaṭʿ (severance). And "the pens" are nominative as the khabar (predicate) of "أَنَّ".

akhfash:34-34.t: And He said ﴿وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ﴾: you may say "أَيُّ امْرَأَةٍ جاءَتْكَ" and "أَيَّةُ امْرَأَةٍ جاءَتْكَ" (which woman came to you?).

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الم﴾ Letters with no grammatical position. ﴿تِلْكَ آياتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of الكتاب.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَمَدٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿تَرَوْنَها﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عمد. ﴿وَأَلْقى﴾ Conjoined to خلق. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَواسِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ تَمِيدَ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَبَثَّ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِيها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well. ﴿دابَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَأَنْبَتْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well. ﴿زَوْجٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَرِيمٍ﴾ An adjective of زوج; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿هذا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate), and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَرُونِي﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿ماذا﴾ An interrogative noun, mafʿūl bihi of خلق placed first. ﴿خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the interrogative clause stands in place of the second and third mafʿūls of أروني. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بَلِ﴾ A particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ The khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of ضلال; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لُقْمانَ﴾ First mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْحِكْمَةَ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنِ اشْكُرْ﴾ an is explicative (mufassira), redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is explicative and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿مَنْ﴾ A jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَشْكُرْ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); innamā is the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَشْكُرْ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the two clauses of protasis and apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of من, and the clause من.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ A jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ The fāʾ is connective, and a particle resembling the verb, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ﴾ Two khabars; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the two clauses of protasis and apodosis are the khabar of من, and the clause من is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِذْ﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿قالَ لُقْمانُ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِابْنِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَعِظُهُ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يا بُنَيَّ﴾ A vocative particle and the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿لا تُشْرِكْ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the two clauses, the vocative and the verbal, are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿لَظُلْمٌ﴾ The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and its khabar. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa); the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا﴾ The wāw is the wāw of parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ), and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْإِنْسانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِوالِدَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿حَمَلَتْهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl. ﴿أُمُّهُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is parenthetical and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَهْناً﴾ A substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object). ﴿عَلى وَهْنٍ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَفِصالُهُ﴾ The wāw is parenthetical, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي عامَيْنِ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is parenthetical and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنِ اشْكُرْ﴾ an is explicative (mufassira), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is explicative. ﴿لِي﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَلِوالِدَيْكَ﴾ [A preposition and its genitive noun] conjoined to لي. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿جاهَداكَ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى﴾ A preposition. ﴿أَنْ تُشْرِكَ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهداك. ﴿بِي﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ما لَيْسَ﴾ mā is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ Its khabar (predicate), placed first. ﴿بِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ The ism of laysa, placed after; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿فَلا تُطِعْهُما﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وما﴾ [i.e. the mā of ـهما] marks the dual; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿صاحِبْهُما﴾ An imperative verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَعْرُوفاً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿سَبِيلَ مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi annexed to من; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنابَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم.. is the ṣila.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿يا بُنَيَّ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿إِنَّها﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَكُ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the sign of its jussive is the sukūn on the nūn that was dropped for lightening, and its ism is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِثْقالَ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of تك. ﴿حَبَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position, and the vocative clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of حبة. ﴿فَتَكُنْ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and a defective imperfect verb whose ism is latent. ﴿فِي صَخْرَةٍ﴾ The khabar of تكن; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَوْ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to في صخرة. ﴿أَوْ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to في السموات. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿بِهَا اللَّهُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾ Two khabars; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. And in [the conditional particle] together with what it governs is the khabar of إنها.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿يا بُنَيَّ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿أَقِمِ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَصابَكَ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿مِنْ عَزْمِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأُمُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verse is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿هُدىً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾ Conjoined to هدى. ﴿لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رحمة.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ The relative noun is an adjective (ṣifa) of المحسنين. ﴿يُقِيمُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكاةَ﴾ Conjoined to يقيمون الصلاة. The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوقنون. ﴿هُمْ﴾ A pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى هُدىً﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to هدى. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ A pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ The preposition and its genitive noun are a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مِنَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾ here; the word of the verse is مَنْ.] A relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَشْتَرِي﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) annexed to الحديث; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِيُضِلَّ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يشتري. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَتَّخِذَها﴾ An imperfect verb conjoined to ليضل, and hā is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُزُواً﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after. ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب; the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ A non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima). ﴿تُتْلى﴾ A passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿آياتُنا﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلَّى﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مُسْتَكْبِراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ Lightened from the heavy [kaʾanna] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لَمْ يَسْمَعْها﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and hā is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of kaʾan, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ A particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فِي أُذُنَيْهِ﴾ The khabar of kaʾanna, placed first. ﴿وَقْراً﴾ Its ism, placed after; the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ Conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ﴾ A khabar (predicate) placed first and a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿النَّعِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause إن الذين.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِيها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين. ﴿وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَقًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ A mubtadaʾ (subject) and two khabars (predicates); the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿وَلا تُصَعِّرْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿خَدَّكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَمْشِ﴾ Conjoined to ولا تصعر. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَرَحاً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿لا يُحِبُّ﴾ [lā is] negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُخْتالٍ﴾ An adjective of an omitted qualified noun, its implied form being "a servant who is arrogant (ʿabdin mukhtālin)". ﴿فَخُورٍ﴾ A second adjective; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وَاقْصِدْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي مَشْيِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿الْأَصْواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَصَوْتُ﴾ The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿صوت الْحَمِيرِ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of inna, annexed to الحمير; the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَوْا﴾ The hamza is an interrogative particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿سَخَّرَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its ism and its khabar stands in place of the two mafʿūls of تروا. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ Conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿وَأَسْبَغَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿نِعَمَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظاهِرَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَباطِنَةً﴾ Conjoined to ظاهرة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a khabar placed first. ﴿مِنَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾ here; the word of the verse is مَنْ.] mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يُجادِلُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا هُدىً﴾ Conjoined to بغير علم. ﴿وَلا كِتابٍ﴾ Conjoined to بغير علم. ﴿مُنِيرٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب.

daas-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ A non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima). ﴿قِيلَ﴾ A passive past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿اتَّبِعُوا﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of قيل. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿قالُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾ A particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿نَتَّبِعُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آباءَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾ The hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional, and its apodosis is omitted. ﴿كانَ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿يَدْعُوهُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause كان..
is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى عَذابِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿السَّعِيرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿مَنْ﴾ A jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُسْلِمْ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَجْهَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ مُحْسِنٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقَدِ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿اسْتَمْسَكَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالْعُرْوَةِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْوُثْقى﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of العروة; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the two clauses of protasis and apodosis are the khabar, and the clause من.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after. ﴿الْأُمُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ A jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَلا يَحْزُنْكَ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كُفْرُهُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَيْنا مَرْجِعُهُمْ﴾ A khabar (predicate) placed first and a mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ Its khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. The two clauses of protasis and apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من, and the clause من.. is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿نُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿نَضْطَرُّهُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى عَذابٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿غَلِيظٍ﴾ An adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām is the one preparing for an omitted oath (mawṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿مَنْ﴾ An interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ Conjoined to السموات; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of من, and the clause من خلق.. is the second mafʿūl bihi of سأل. ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ The lām falls in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the dropped wāw of the plural is the fāʿil, and the nūn is a particle of emphasis with no grammatical position; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ The Divine Name is the fāʿil of an omitted verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلِ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name and the preposition are the khabar; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾ A particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ The preposition and the Divine Name in the genitive are a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿ما﴾ A relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ Conjoined to السموات. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿هُوَ﴾ A pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ﴾ Two khabars of inna; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ A particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿ما﴾ The ism of anna. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَقْلامٌ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its ism and its khabar is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb which what follows explains. The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَالْبَحْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَمُدُّهُ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the khabar of البحر, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ﴾ fāʿil, annexed to أبحر. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿نَفِدَتْ كَلِماتُ اللَّهِ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the answer of law and has no grammatical position [Translator's note: the source reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently «جواب لو لا محل لها» run together]. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ Two khabars; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿خَلْقُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا بَعْثُكُمْ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَنَفْسٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of بعثكم. ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of نفس. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾ inna, its ism and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ The hamza is an interrogative particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿يُولِجُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي النَّهارِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its ism and its khabar stands in place of the two mafʿūls of ترى. ﴿وَيُولِجُ النَّهارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ Conjoined as well. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of أجل. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and anna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. The interpreted maṣdar formed from anna, its ism and its khabar is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿ذلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the bāʾ is a preposition; and anna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿هُوَ﴾ A pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its ism and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنَّ ما﴾ anna and its ism. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْباطِلُ﴾ The khabar of anna; the interpreted maṣdar formed from anna, its ism and its khabar is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿هُوَ﴾ A pronoun of separation. ﴿الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ﴾ Two khabars of anna; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ The hamza is an interrogative particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ﴾ anna and its ism. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its ism and its khabar stands in place of the two mafʿūls of تر. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُرِيَكُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تجري. ﴿مِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word of the verse is إِنَّ, and the analysis that follows treats it as inna.] A particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ The khabar of inna, placed first; and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ The ism of inna, placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of آيات. ﴿صَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and it is an adjective of an omitted qualified noun. ﴿شَكُورٍ﴾ A second adjective.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِذا غَشِيَهُمْ﴾ iḏā is a non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima), and a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿مَوْجٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿كَالظُّلَلِ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of موج. ﴿دَعَوُا اللَّهَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil, and the Divine Name is its mafʿūl; the clause is the answer of iḏā and has no grammatical position. ﴿مُخْلِصِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَهُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿لما﴾ A conditional adverb. ﴿نَجَّاهُمْ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa). ﴿منهم﴾ A khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مُقْتَصِدٌ﴾ A mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَما﴾ negating. ﴿يَجْحَدُ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُلُّ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿خَتَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "a treacherous servant (ʿabd khattār)". ﴿كَفُورٍ﴾ A second adjective; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:33-33.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ A vocative particle and the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿اتَّقُوا﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاخْشَوْا﴾ Conjoined to اتقوا. ﴿يَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَجْزِي والِدٌ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ وَلَدِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of يوما. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿مَوْلُودٌ﴾
Conjoined to والد. ﴿هُوَ جازٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is an adjective of مولود. ﴿عَنْ والِدِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاز. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ inna and its ism, annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ Its khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَلا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ An adjective of الحياة; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ An adverb of place, a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿عِلْمُ﴾ A mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause إن الله ... is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿السَّاعَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْغَيْثَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾ Conjoined to ينزل. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْحامِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿ماذا﴾ An interrogative noun, a mafʿūl bihi placed first. ﴿تَكْسِبُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿غَداً﴾ An adverb of time; the clause stands in place of the two mafʿūls of تدري. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِأَيِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تموت. ﴿أَرْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَمُوتُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl of تدري. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾ Its two khabars; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

farraa:3-3.t: His saying: ﴿هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً﴾: Most readers put "guidance" and "mercy" in the accusative by severance (ʿalā al-qaṭʿ, i.e. as a ḥāl). Ḥamza put them in the nominative as a new beginning (iʾtināf), because it begins anew in a verse separate from the verse before it. In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is (هُدًى وبُشْرى).

farraa:6-6.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ﴾: it was revealed about al-Naḍr ibn al-Ḥārith al-Dārī. He used to buy the books of the non-Arabs, Persia and Rome, and the books of the people of al-Ḥīra, (and relate) them to the people of Mecca; and when he heard the Quran he would turn away from it and mock it. That is His saying ﴿وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُواً﴾. The readers differed over ﴿وَيَتَّخِذَهَا﴾: most of them put it in the nominative, and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash and his companions put it in the accusative. Whoever reads the nominative refers it back to ﴿يَشْتَرِي﴾, and whoever reads the accusative refers it back to His saying ﴿لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ﴾: "and so that he may take it".
His saying ﴿وَيَتَّخِذَهَا﴾ refers to the verses of the Quran. And if you wish, you may make it refer to "the way", because "the way" (al-sabīl) may be feminine; He said ﴿قُلْ هذِهِ سَبِيلِى أَدعُو إِلَي اللهِ﴾, and in the reading of Ubayy: (وإنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُشْدِ لاَ يَتّخذُوهَا سَبِيلاً وَإنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الغَىّ يَتّخِذُوهَا سَبِيلاً).
Abū al-ʿAbbās related to us, saying: Muḥammad related to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Ḥibbān related to me from Layth from Mujāhid about His saying ﴿وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ﴾, he said: it is singing. Al-Farrāʾ said: and the first is its interpretation from Ibn ʿAbbās.

farraa:10-10.t:
His saying: ﴿وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ﴾: lest it sway with you. (أَنْ) in this position suffices in place of (لا), as the poet said:
* والمهرُ يأبى أن يزال مُلهِبا *
(And the colt refuses to stop running at a blazing pace.)
Its meaning is: refuses not to keep on.

farraa:11-11.t: His saying: ﴿هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ﴾: [referring to] what He mentioned of the heavens and the earth, His sending down water from the sky, and His causing [plants] to grow. ﴿فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ﴾ you worship ﴿مِن دُونِهِ﴾, meaning their gods. Then He gave them the lie, saying ﴿بَلِ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ﴾.

farraa:12-12.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ﴾: Abū al-ʿAbbās related to us, saying: Muḥammad related to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: [145/a] Ḥibbān related to me from someone who related to him, who said: Luqmān was an Abyssinian, with a mutilated nose and thick lips.

farraa:15-15.t: His saying: ﴿وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفاً﴾: i.e. keep good company with them.

farraa:16-16.t:
His saying: ﴿يٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ﴾: "the weight" may be accusative or nominative. Whoever reads the nominative makes it nominative by takun, the indefinite tolerating having no predicate (fiʿl) with kāna, laysa and their sisters. Whoever reads the accusative places in (تكن) an implied, unspecified noun, like the hāʾ in His saying ﴿إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ﴾, and like His saying ﴿فَإنَّهَا لاَ تَعْمَى الأبصارُ﴾. The feminine of (تك) is permissible though "weight" is masculine, because it is annexed to "the grain", and the meaning is about the grain, so the feminine went to it, as he said:
وتشرق بالقول الذى قد أَذَعتَه * كَمَا شَرِقت صَدرُ القناة من الدمِ
(You choke on the word you have spread abroad, as the breast of the spear is choked with blood.)
Had it been ﴿إِن يَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ﴾ it would be correct, and both ways would be permissible in it. His saying ﴿فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ﴾: it is said that it is the rock beneath the earth, which is Sijjīn, in which the deeds of the disbelievers are written. His saying ﴿يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ﴾: and He will requite for it.

farraa:18-18.t: His saying: ﴿وَلاَ تُصَاعِرْ﴾: the people of Medina, ʿĀṣim ibn Abī al-Najūd and al-Ḥasan read it (تصعِّر) with doubling, and Yaḥyā and his companions read it with the alif: ﴿ولا تُصاعِرْ﴾. He says: do not turn your cheek away from people — from your saying "a man who is aṣʿar (wry-necked)". One may also say "wa-lā tuṣʿir", but I have not heard it.

farraa:19-19.t: His saying: ﴿إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ﴾: he says: the ugliest of voices is the voice of donkeys. You say: "he has an unpleasant (munkar) face" when it is ugly. He said ﴿لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ﴾; had it been said "the voices of donkeys" it would be correct. But "voice", although attributed to a plural, the plural in this position is like the singular.

farraa:20-20.t: His saying: ﴿وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً﴾: Abū al-ʿAbbās related to us, saying: Muḥammad related to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Sharīk ibn ʿAbd Allāh related to me from Khaṣīf al-Jazarī from ʿIkrima from Ibn ʿAbbās that he read (نِعْمَةً), in the singular. Ibn ʿAbbās said: had it been ﴿نِعَمَهُ﴾, it would be one favour below another favour — or he said: one favour above another favour; the doubt is al-Farrāʾ's. Some people read ﴿نِعَمُه﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source] as a plural. That is a good reading, because He said ﴿شَاكِراً لأنعُمِه اجْتَباهُ﴾, and this is a plural of favours, which is evidence that ﴿نِعَمَهُ﴾ is permissible.

farraa:22-22.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ﴾: the readers read it with the light form, except Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, who read it (وَمَنْ يُسَلِّم). It is like your saying to a man: "Commit (aslim) your affair to Allah" and "Hand it over (sallim)".

farraa:27-27.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلاَمٌ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ﴾: You put ﴿البحر﴾ in the nominative; had you put it in the accusative it would be correct, just as the readers read ﴿وَإذا قِيل إنَّ وَعْدَ اللهِ حَقٌّ والسَّاعَةُ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا﴾ and ﴿الساعة﴾ [i.e. in the accusative]. In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: ﴿وبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ﴾. He says: it would be ink (midād), like the ink one writes with. ʿAbd Allāh's reading strengthens the nominative. When a thing extends (madda) another thing and increases it, being an increase to it, it "yamudduhu"; you say: "The Tigris feeds (tamuddu) our wells and our rivers", and "Allah supplies us (yumiddunā) with it". You say: "I reinforced you (amdadtuka) with a thousand, and they swelled your numbers (maddūka)". Everything that comes is measured on this.

farraa:28-28.t: His saying: ﴿مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلاَ بَعْثُكُمْ إِلاَّ كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾: except like the raising of a single soul. He left "raising" implied because it is an action, as He said ﴿تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كالذِى يُغْشَى عَلَيْهِ (مِنَ المَوْتِ)﴾; the meaning — and Allah knows best — is: like the rolling of the eye of one who faints / [145/b] from death; He left both "rolling" and "eye" implied.

farraa:31-31.t: His saying: ﴿بِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ﴾: it has been read ﴿بنعِمَاتِ الله﴾. The Arabs seldom do that with the pattern fiʿla — make its plural with the tāʾ; they only make its plural on fiʿal, like sidra and sidar (lote trees), khirqa and khiraq (rags). They disliked its plural with the tāʾ only because they oblige themselves to give its second letter kasra when it is pluralised, just as they pluralised ẓulma as ẓulumāt and gave its second letter ḍamma following the ḍamma of its first, and as they said ḥasarāt, making its second follow its first. When they would have been obliged to say bi-niʿimāt, they found it heavy for two kasras to follow one another in their speech, for we have not found that except in ibil (camels) alone. Some of the Arabs have tolerated it and said niʿimāt and sidirāt.

farraa:32-32.t: His saying: ﴿كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ﴾: al-khattār is the treacherous. His saying ﴿مَوْجٌ كالظُلَلِ﴾: He likened it to canopies (ẓulal), while "wave" is singular, because waves ride upon one another and come one thing after another; so He said ﴿كالظُلَل﴾, meaning clouds.

farraa:33-33.t: His saying: ﴿بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ﴾: whatever deludes you is gharūr: Satan is gharūr, and this world is gharūr. You say: gharartuhu ghurūran (I deluded him). Had it been read "wa-lā yaghurrannakum bi-llāhi al-ghurūr", meaning the adornment of things, it would be correct.

farraa:34-34.t:
His saying: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلأَرْحَامِ﴾: it carries the interpretation of a negation; the meaning is: no one else knows it. ﴿وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَداً﴾: this came out as a negation; the meaning is overt, and the first is known by the implied negation.
His saying ﴿بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ﴾ and bi-ayyati arḍin: whoever says ﴿بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ﴾ is content with the femininity of "land" and does not show another feminine marker in ayy; whoever uses the feminine says: they have sometimes made do with ayy without what it is annexed to, so the feminine is necessary, as in your saying "I passed by a woman", and you say: "ayyatin (which one)?", and "I passed by two men" [Translator's note: the source has «بجرلين», a slip for «برجلين»], and you say: "ayyayni (which two)?"

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حملته أمه وهنا على وهن وفصاله في عامين﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); وصينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الإنسان: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بوالديه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وصينا﴾; the clause ﴿وصينا الإنسان بوالديه﴾ is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position. حملته أمه: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; وهنًا: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أمه; على وهن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وهنا﴾; the clause ﴿حملته أمه ...﴾ is parenthetical between the explained and the explanation, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; فصاله: mubtadaʾ (subject); في عامين: khabar (predicate).
﴿أن اشكر لي ولوالديك﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. اشكر: an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; لي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اشكر; لوالديك: conjoined to لي.
﴿إلي المصير﴾: إلَيَّ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; المصير: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إلي المصير﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وإن جاهداك على أن تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن: conditional; جاهداك: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿جاهداك﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); على: a preposition, and ﴿أن تشرك﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهداك; بي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تشرك; ما: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; ليس: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb; لك: the fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علم; علم: the postponed noun of ليس; the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. فلا: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is prohibitive; تطعهما: an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm and alif are two particles indicating the dual; the clause ﴿فلا تطعهما﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; صاحبهما: an imperative verb, a latent fāʿil implied as "you", and a mafʿūl bihi; في الدنيا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial); معروفا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a kindly companionship" (صحابا معروفا), or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "with kindness" (بالمعروف).
﴿واتبع سبيل من أناب إلي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتبع: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "you"; سبيل: mafʿūl bihi; من: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause أناب is the ṣila of مَن, with no grammatical position. إليَّ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أناب.
﴿ثم إلي مرجعكم فأنبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; إليَّ: a fronted khabar; مرجعكم: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). فأنبئكم: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنبئكم: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil implied as "I", and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنبئكم; كنتم: كان, a defective past verb, the tāʾ being its noun; the clause تعملون: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿يا بني إنها إن تك مثقال حبة من خردل﴾: يا: a vocative particle; بني: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun; إنْ: conditional; تَكُ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was dropped for lightening; the noun of تَكُ is latent (mustatir); مثقال: the khabar (predicate) of تَكُ; حبة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من خردل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of حبة.
﴿فتكن في صخرة أو في السماوات أو في الأرض يأت بها الله إن الله لطيف خبير﴾: فتكن: conjoined to تَكُ; the noun of تكن is latent, implied as "it" (هي); في صخرة: the khabar of تكن; ﴿أو في السماوات أو في الأرض﴾: conjoined to ﴿في صخرة﴾; يأت: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; بها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأت﴾; الله: fāʿil (agent); إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; لطيف خبير: its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿يا بني أقم الصلاة وأمر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر على ما أصابك﴾: يا: a vocative particle; بني: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; أقم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) necessarily latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأمر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر على ما أصابك﴾: conjoined to ﴿أقم الصلاة﴾.
﴿إن ذلك من عزم الأمور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ذلك: the noun of إن; من عزم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of إن; الأمور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الأرض مرحا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: prohibitive; تصعر: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; خدك: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تصعر; ولا تمش: conjoined to ﴿ولا تصعر﴾; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تمش﴾; مرحًا: a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a jaunty walking" (مشيًا مرحًا), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿إن الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause ﴿لا يحب﴾: its khabar (predicate); كل: the object of يحب; مختال: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); فخور: conjoined to مختال.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿واقصد في مشيك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اقصد: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; في مشيك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقصد.
﴿واغضض من صوتك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اغضض: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "you"; من صوتك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اغضض, or attached to an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "lower something of your voice" (اغضض شيئا من صوتك).
﴿إن أنكر الأصوات لصوت الحمير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أنكر: its noun; الأصوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis; صوت الحمير: the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ألم تروا أن الله سخر لكم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: a resumptive (mustaʾnafa) clause with no grammatical position; the hamza is for disapproving or affirmative interrogation; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; تروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause سخر: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخر; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وما في الأرض: conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾; the clause ﴿أن الله سخر...﴾ stands in place of the two objects of تروا.
﴿وأسبغ عليكم نعمه ظاهرة وباطنة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أسبغ: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿أسبغ﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سخر﴾; عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسبغ; نعمه: mafʿūl bihi; ظاهرة: ḥāl (circumstantial); باطنة: conjoined to ظاهرة.
﴿ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم ولا هدى ولا كتاب منير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من الناس: a fronted khabar; مَن: a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿يجادل﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. في الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجادل﴾; بغير علم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يجادل. The clause ﴿ومن الناس...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ولا هدى: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is for emphasising the negation, and هدى is conjoined to ﴿علم﴾, genitive; ولا كتاب: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is for emphasising the negation, and كتاب is conjoined to ﴿علم﴾, genitive; منير: an adjective of كتاب.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما أنزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل; the clause ﴿اتبعوا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb), and it is conjoining to an omitted clause, i.e. "they said: we will not follow what Allah has sent down; rather we follow ... etc." (قالوا لا نتبع ما أنزل الله بل نتبع ...إلخ). نتبع: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "we"; ما: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿وجدنا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وجدنا, or attached to the second object of وجدنا, i.e. "we found our fathers devoted to it" (وجدنا آباءنا عاكفين عليه); آباءنا: the first object of وجدنا.
﴿أولو كان الشيطان يدعوهم إلى عذاب السعير﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the wāw has two possible analyses: first, that it is a conjunction joining to something omitted; second, that it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); in either case something omitted must be supplied, the implied form being: "Will they follow him even if Satan was calling them?" (أيتبعونه ولو كان الشيطان يدعوهم). لو: conditional, its apodosis omitted, implied as "they followed him" (اتبعوه); the clause ﴿ولو كان الشيطان﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of the implied يتبعونه; كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); الشيطان: its noun; the clause ﴿يدعوهم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان; إلى عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدعوهم; السعير: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ومن يسلم وجهه إلى الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يسلم: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; وجهه: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسلم; the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl); هو: mubtadaʾ; محسن: khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وهو محسن﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يسلم. فقد: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); استمسك: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; بالعروة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استمسك; الوثقى: an adjective of العروة; the clause ﴿فقد استمسك﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and apodosis clauses together are in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, which is the conditional noun; the clause ﴿ومن يسلم وجهه...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإلى الله عاقبة الأمور﴾: إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; عاقبة: a postponed mubtadaʾ; الأمور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿من كفر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿من يسلم﴾; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); كفر: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا: prohibitive; يحزنك: an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; the clause ﴿فلا يحزنك كفره﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The protasis and apodosis clauses together are in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, which is the conditional noun.
﴿إلينا مرجعهم فننبئهم بما عملوا﴾: إلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar; مرجعهم: a postponed mubtadaʾ. فننبئهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ننبئهم: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "we", the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural. بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ننبئهم; the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عليم: the khabar of إن; بذات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم; الصدور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾ has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the clause ﴿فننبئهم بما عملوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم إلى عذاب غليظ﴾: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position; نمتعهم: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); قليلا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We give them a little enjoyment" (نمتعهم متاعًا قليلا), or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "We give them enjoyment for a little time" (نمتعهم زمانا قليلا). ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; نضطرهم: a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; إلى عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نضطرهم; غليظ: an adjective of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for an oath (mūṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن: conditional; سألتهم: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿من خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second object of سألتهم. ليقولن: the lām occurs in the response to the oath; يقولن: an imperfect verb from which the nūn of the nominative has been dropped because of a succession of like letters, and the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; الله: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is Allah" (هو الله), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "Allah is their Creator" (الله خالقها). The clause ﴿ولئن سألتهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل الحمد لله﴾: قل: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; الحمد: mubtadaʾ; لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿الحمد لله﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أكثرهم: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾: khabar.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿لله ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); ما: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. الأرض: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿إن الله هو الغني الحميد﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being the noun of إن; هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الغني: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); الحميد: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولو أنما في الأرض من شجرة أقلام﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو: a non-jussive conditional particle; أنما: أنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿ما﴾ is its noun; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. من شجرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; أقلام: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
﴿والبحر يمده من بعده سبعة أبحر ما نفدت كلمات الله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction; البحر: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يمده﴾ is its khabar; يمده: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من بعده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from ﴿سبعة أبحر﴾, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); سبعة: the fāʿil (agent) of يمده; أبحر: muḍāf ilayhi. ما: negative; نفدت: a past verb; كلمات الله: fāʿil, the word of majesty being muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ولو أنما في الأرض...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عزيز: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); حكيم: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم إلا كنفس واحدة﴾: ما: negative; خلقكم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is for emphasising the negation; بعثكم: conjoined to خلقكم; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); كنفس: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of خلْق, with a muḍāf omitted, the implied form being: "except like the creation and resurrection of a single soul" (إلا مثل خلق وبعث نفس واحدة).
﴿إن الله سميع بصير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; سميع: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); بصير: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ترَ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يولج النهار في الليل﴾: conjoined to the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of تَرَ.
﴿وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري إلى أجل مسمى وأن الله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سخر: conjoined to يولج; الشمس: the object of سخر; القمر: conjoined to الشمس; كل: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يجري﴾: khabar; إلى أجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجري; مسمى: a naʿt (adjective) of أجل; أنّ: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبير; تعملون: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. خبير: the khabar of أنّ.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله هو الحق﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); the bāʾ is a preposition; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الحق: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; or هو: mubtadaʾ, and الحق: the khabar of هو, and the clause ﴿هو الحق﴾ is the khabar of أنّ; أنّ with its noun and khabar is an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ذلك.
﴿وأن ما يدعون من دونه الباطل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ: an abrogating particle; ما: the noun of أنّ; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. من دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted object of يدعون, the implied form being: "and that what they call upon besides Him" (وأن ما يدعونه من دونه). الباطل: the khabar of أنّ.
﴿وأن الله هو العلي الكبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; هو: mubtadaʾ; العلي: a first khabar of أنّ; الكبير: a second khabar of أنّ; the nominal clause ﴿هو العلي الكبير﴾ is the khabar of أنّ. [Translator's note: the source calls هو a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿هو العلي الكبير﴾ the khabar of أنّ, yet also calls العلي and الكبير the first and second khabar of أنّ; presumably العلي and الكبير are meant as the khabars of هو. Translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; تر: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الفلك is its noun; the clause ﴿تجري في البحر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; بنعمة الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تجري, i.e. "accompanied by His favour" (مصحوبة بنعمته).
﴿ليريكم من آياته﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); يريكم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the lām, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural; the concealed أن and the imperfect verb form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the causal lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تجري﴾. من آياته: a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the second object of يريكم.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle; في ذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات: the noun of إن; لكل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of آيات; صبار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); شكور: an adjective of صبار.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وإذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; غشيهم: a past verb, the pronoun being mafʿūl bihi (direct object); موج: fāʿil (agent); كالظلل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of موج; the clause ﴿غشيهم﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; دعوا: a verb and its fāʿil; الله: the word of majesty, the object of دعوا; the clause ﴿دعوا الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; مخلصين: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of دعوا; له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مخلصين; الدين: the object of مخلصين, because ﴿مخلصين﴾ is an active participle.
﴿فلما نجاهم إلى البر فمنهم مقتصد﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما: an adverb meaning "when" (حين) containing the sense of condition; نجاهم: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; إلى البر: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نجاهم; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); مقتصد: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا كل ختار كفور﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما: negative; يجحد: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); بآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجحد; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); كل: fāʿil; ختار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); كفور: an adjective of ختار; the clause ﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده﴾: يا أيها: يا is a vocative particle; أيُّ: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها: for drawing attention (tanbīh); الناس: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); اتقوا ربكم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); اخشوا: conjoined to اتقوا; يومًا: mafʿūl bihi; لا: negative; يجزي والد: a verb and its fāʿil; عن ولده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجزي; the clause ﴿لا يجزي والد عن ولده﴾ is in the position of accusative as an adjective of ﴿يومًا﴾.
﴿ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: for emphasising the negation; مولود: mubtadaʾ (subject); هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); جازٍ: khabar (predicate), nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped yāʾ; or هو: a second mubtadaʾ, and جازٍ: the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿هو جاز﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ; عن والده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاز﴾; شيئا: a mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ﴿جاز﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "anything of requital" (شيئا من الجزاء). The clause ﴿لا مولود ...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يجزي...﴾.
﴿إن وعد الله حق﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); وعد: the noun of إن, the word of majesty (Allah) being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); حق: the khabar of إن.
﴿فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (faṣīḥa), i.e. "if you know that Allah's promise is true, then do not let the life of this world delude you" (إذا علمتم أن وعد الله حق فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا); لا: prohibitive; تغرنكم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi; الحياة: the fāʿil of تغرنكم; الدنيا: an adjective of الحياة.
﴿ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: prohibitive; يغرنكم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive by the prohibitive لا, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi; بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغرنكم﴾; الغرور: the fāʿil of يغرنكم; the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿إن الله عنده علم الساعة وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الأرحام﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عنده: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); علم الساعة: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿عنده علم الساعة﴾ is the khabar of إن; the wāw is a conjunction; ينزل الغيث: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يعلم: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; في الأرحام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; تدري: an imperfect verb; نفس: fāʿil; ماذا: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted object of تكسب; غدا: an adverb attached to تكسب; the clause ﴿ماذا تكسب غدا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿تدري﴾; the clause ﴿وما تدري نفس...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن الله عنده علم الساعة﴾.
﴿وما تدري نفس بأي أرض تموت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; تدري: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); نفس: fāʿil; بأي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تموت; أرض: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿بأي أرض تموت﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿تدري﴾.
﴿إن الله عليم خبير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; عليم: the khabar of إن, nominative; خبير: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat Luqmān
Meccan, except for three verses of it which are Medinan: His saying ﴿وَلَوْ أنَّما في الأرْضِ﴾ [Luqmān: 27], to the end of the three verses.
﷽
﴿الم﴾ — Ibn ʿAbbās said: the meaning of ”الـم“ is "I am Allah, I know best." We have explained in Sūrat al-Baqara everything that has been said about ”الـم“ and what resembles it.

zajjaj:10-10.t:
His saying: ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَها وألْقى في الأرْضِ رَواسِيَ﴾ — Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, described His creation, the like of which created beings are unable to produce, or to manage any kind of it; then He said: ﴿هَذا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَأرُونِي ماذا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ﴾ [Luqmān: 11].
His saying: ﴿بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَها﴾ — it has been said in the tafsīr: it is with pillars that you do not see, i.e. you do not see those pillars. And it has been said: He created it without pillars, and so you see it.
The meaning in the tafsīr comes down to one thing: the interpretation of ”بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَها“ which was explained as "with pillars that you do not see" is that the meaning of the pillars is His power, Mighty and Majestic is He, by which He holds the heavens and the earth. ﴿وَألْقى في الأرْضِ رَواسِيَ أنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ﴾ — ”رَواسِي“ are firm mountains, as He, Mighty and Majestic is He, said: ﴿ألَمْ نَجْعَلِ الأرْضَ مِهادًا﴾ [al-Nabaʾ: 6] ﴿والجِبالَ أوْتادًا﴾ [al-Nabaʾ: 7]. So the meaning of ”أنْ تَمِيدَ بِكم“ is "lest it should shake with you" (literally "out of dislike that it should shake with you"), and the meaning of ”تَمِيدَ“ is: move with a violent movement.

zajjaj:12-12.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنا لُقْمانَ الحِكْمَةَ أنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ﴾ — its meaning is "so that you give thanks to Allah." It is also possible that ”أنْ“ is explicative (mufassira), so the meaning would be: "that is: give thanks to Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He." The interpretation of ”أنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ“ is: "We said to him: give thanks to Allah for what He has given you." There has been disagreement in the tafsīr about Luqmān: it has been said he was a prophet; it has been said he was a sage; it has been said he was a righteous man; and it has been said he was an Abyssinian with thick lips and cracked feet, but Allah gave him wisdom. We have no doubt that he was a sage, because of Allah's saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنا لُقْمانَ الحِكْمَةَ﴾. It has been said he was a carpenter; it has been said he was a tailor; and it has been said he was a shepherd. It is related in the tafsīr that a man stood before him while he was in his assembly and said to him: "Are you not the one who used to herd with me in such-and-such a place?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Then what has brought you to what I see?" He said: "Truthfulness in speech, and silence about what does not concern me."

zajjaj:13-13.t:
His saying: ﴿وَإذْ قالَ لُقْمانُ لابْنِهِ وهو يَعِظُهُ﴾ — the position of ”إذْ“ is accusative, by His saying ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنا لُقْمانَ الحِكْمَةَ﴾ [Luqmān: 12], i.e. "We gave Luqmān wisdom when he said…", because this admonition is wisdom.
His saying: ﴿إنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾ — He means that Allah alone is the One who gives life and death, the Provider and Bestower of blessings, without partner; so if anyone other than Him is associated with Him, that is the greatest wrong, because he has attributed the blessing to someone other than its Lord. The root meaning of ”اَلظُّلْمُ“ in the language is putting a thing in other than its place; we have explained that earlier in the book.
